parent_objective: audit bounded source-only fixture smoke before pilot design, synthesis, or further interface milestones
blocked_by: M2484 source-only fixture smoke result must be audited before it is used to justify pilot design
bounded smoke evidence must not be confused with validation or driver performance
branch may need synthesis if another interface step would add no executable evidence
supersedes: direct pilot design from unaudited source-only fixture smoke
direct high-fidelity validation route from source-only adapter smoke

public_gates: M2485 must audit M2484 summary and fixture smoke rows
M2485 must decide whether to route to bounded pilot design synthesis or stop
M2485 must preserve P0 observation shape 72 and action shape 3 as admission criteria
M2485 must not treat canned source-only smoke actions as policy performance
M2485 must not install import or run external high-fidelity simulation
M2485 must not train rank controllers select winners or make paper self-ID finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim or high-fidelity validation claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not install external simulator dependencies
do not import external high-fidelity simulation packages
do not run external high-fidelity simulation
do not change the deployed action contract
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim high-fidelity validation readiness
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits executable source-only fixture smoke before pilot design or branch synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-only fixture smoke result audit only; no external simulation, measured validation, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, or validation verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2484 changed actor/action contracts
stop if M2484 leaked fixture labels or diagnostics into actor input
stop if M2484 is being interpreted as driver performance or validation evidence
stop if another interface milestone would add no executable backend evidence
fallback_plan: route to fixture smoke repair if actor/action or metadata boundary fails
route to branch synthesis if process overhead dominates evidence expansion
route to bounded pilot design only if smoke evidence is complete and correctly scoped
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2484 produced executable source-only fixture smoke evidence after multiple HF0 interface milestones

training_stage.stage_objective: HF0 source-only fixture smoke result audit
blocked_shortcuts: no external simulator installation or import
allowed_updates: M2485 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2485 audits source-only fixture smoke and does not test history necessity or current-frame substitution.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2485; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2478 through M2484 HF0 interface preparation evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If smoke evidence is incomplete, route to repair or synthesis instead of weakening claims.
allowed_claims: no high-fidelity validation result, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits new executable source-only fixture smoke evidence before further route selection
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can prepare validation infrastructure but cannot itself establish paper or high-fidelity evidence
must_synthesize_if: M2484 smoke result is incomplete or ambiguous
another interface milestone would not add executable evidence
process overhead exceeds evidence expansion after source-only smoke

hypothesis: Auditing the M2484 source-only fixture smoke can determine whether the branch should route to bounded pilot design, repair, or synthesis without overstating evidence.
success_criteria: audit checks M2484 summary and fixture smoke rows
audit verifies observation shape 72 and action shape 3 remain preserved
audit verifies no fixture labels diagnostics or oracle values enter actor input
audit registers a bounded follow-up milestone
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2485 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2485 changes actor input or action contract
M2485 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2485 treats canned actions as policy performance
M2485 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2485 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result
decision_rule: M2485 passes if it audits M2484 source-only fixture smoke evidence and chooses a bounded next route without external simulation, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
